# Search for cutting boards under $30 (max_price is product price; tax checked after adding to cart)
query = 'cutting board'
max_price = 30.0
page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
all_products = []
while True:
    page = apis.amazon.search_products(query=query, max_price=max_price, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page_index', page_index, 'returned', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_products.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('total_products_returned', len(all_products))

# Filter to trusted sellers
qualifying = [p for p in all_products if p.get('seller_id') in trusted_seller_ids]
print('qualifying_count_trusted_sellers', len(qualifying))
# Show a few qualifying candidates
qualifying_sorted = sorted(qualifying, key=lambda p: (-p.get('rating', 0), p.get('price', 1e9)))
print('top_candidates (rating, price, seller_id, name):')
for p in qualifying_sorted[:10]:
    print(p.get('rating'), p.get('price'), p.get('seller_id'), p.get('name'))

access_token = tok['access_token']
trusted_seller_ids_set = set(trusted_seller_ids)  # from earlier
# Filter candidates to actual cutting boards based on name/description/product_type text
needle = 'cutting board'
candidates = []
for p in all_products:
    name_l = (p.get('name') or '').lower()
    desc_l = (p.get('description') or '').lower()
    type_l = (p.get('product_type') or '').lower() if p.get('product_type') else ''
    if needle in name_l or needle in desc_l or needle in type_l:
        if p.get('seller_id') in trusted_seller_ids_set:
            # price already <= 30 by search filter
